subject.title: Feature: Configurable Permissions-Policy and CSP headers for Control UI

question: Should OpenClaw expose configurable Control UI CSP and Permissions-Policy headers, and which directives and value forms should be supported?
rationale: This would change browser security boundaries for the authenticated Control UI and add new gateway config surface, so automation should not choose the policy contract.

options.title: Approve Narrow Typed Policy
options.body: Add directive-limited gateway.controlUi policy config with strict validation and tests while preserving hardened defaults.

options.title: Prefer Same-Origin Extension Route
options.body: Decline general header overrides and steer local API integrations toward plugin or gateway routes that avoid weakening browser policy.

options.title: Keep Fixed Allowlists
options.body: Reject configurability for now and continue adding narrowly justified built-in allowlist entries only for core-owned Control UI features.

recommendation.title: Approve Narrow Typed Policy
recommendation.body: Add directive-limited gateway.controlUi policy config with strict validation and tests while preserving hardened defaults.

likelyOwner.reason: This crosses Control UI CSP, gateway config, and security default policy where his recent adjacent history is strongest.
